Chapter 6878: Is Gu Chun Here?

Chapter 6878: Is Gu Chun Here?

“Guardian Alliance!” Immortal Devourer became startled to see the new arrivals.

“You got that right. I, Tun Ri, finally have the chance to go all out in Stygian.” Immortal Tun Ri laughed.

“The damned nine worlds, should have eaten all of them back then.” Extinguish cursed.

“Are you forgetting about our thirteen continents?” An unrestrained old man joked.

“Brother Unconcealable, we did come a bit later.” The immortal with the archaic grace said.

“The summoning means we are here to work.” A youth with a bronze sword prepared his blade.

The steady immortal glanced at him and said: “Don’t think about fighting alone, that is not our dao.”

“You’re right, have to fix the bad habit.” The youth tapped his forehead and sheathed his blade again.

“I’ve been eager to try our Immortal Dao Skyshaker.” Tun Ri said.

“Wipe out Devouring Alliance and capture Gu Chun is the plan today.” The steady immortal smiled.

“Is Gu Chun here?” Tun Ri stared at Extinguish and Mirage.

“Little brats, already so arrogant after only recently becoming immortals.” Southconch uttered coldly.

“We are just better despite starting later.” Tun Ri laughed: “It is the era of the primordial, your era is over.”

The fallen immortals couldn’t refute since this was indeed the era of the primordial trees. Heavenrealm changed dramatically after the Enlightener’s dao proliferation.

Cultivation became easier for all worlds with the help of the primordial trees. Previously, worlds had different cultivation systems and dao sources. Now, primordial chaos true energy became universal.

Those from the nine worlds and thirteen continents had an even easier time due to their strong foundation and dao heart. They didn’t refuse the new energy and took advantage of it to become immortals.

As for the older immortals, they already had their worlds and dao. They didn’t accept the primordial trees as readily. This meant abandoning their old system.

They were proud and couldn’t admit their dao was inferior. Therefore, taking the next step became harder.

As for the few decisive ones, they happily accepted this and fused their grand dao with it. This helped them reach the next step.

Of course, not everyone had a choice. This included the fallen ones, whether they be overlords or immortals. The primordial chaos true energy rejected them due to their nature.

To break through, they had to come up with a new path. This was impossible since their dao heart was shaken when they chose the darkness.

“Stygian isn’t a place for your alliance.” Netherlight said.

“Kill them first!” Big-foot activated his boots again.

“Go!” Extinguish and Mirage prepared for battle.

“Let’s show them our Skyshaker.” The steady immortal activated his dao.

Very well.” Tun Ri and the others raised one foot.

Various dao appeared and connected to form a circular array of the sound affinity, trapping all five fallen immortals.

“Attack!” Big-foot utilized his incredible speed, wanting to leave the array.

Netherlight’s abyss turned into a bloody jaw, releasing a temporal light capable of rotting everything, whether it be immortals or the strongest metal.

Extinguish’s gray aura was of the death affinity. The area around him died instantly, replaced by a yellow river.

“Skyshaker!” Guardian’s members shouted and stomped.

“Boom!” A deafening blast erupted with their stomp. The sky served as the largest drum, producing a sound sweeping through all of creation. This felt like the roar of the high heaven.

The array infinitely amplified their dao, producing surging sound waves that easily nullified the fallen ones’ attacks.

Mirage’s group couldn’t believe it. Not only were their attacks nullified, but the sound waves also threatened their soul and made their knees tremble.

Immortals or not, all feared the high heaven. This was especially true for the fallen ones with inferior dao heart and willpower.

“Rumble!” They activated their toughest defenses but this seemed futile against the high heaven’s roar.
